conversations_subject_length_check.name: conversations_subject_length_check
conversations_subject_length_check.value: "conversations"."subject" is null or char_length("conversations"."subject") between 1 and 200

follow_graph_followee_target_check.name: follow_graph_followee_target_check
follow_graph_followee_target_check.value:
("follow_graph"."followee_kind" = 'audience_user' and "follow_graph"."followee_audience_user_id" is not null and "follow_graph"."followee_creator_profile_ref" is null)
          or ("follow_graph"."followee_kind" = 'creator_profile' and "follow_graph"."followee_audience_user_id" is null and "follow_graph"."followee_creator_profile_ref" is not null)

messages_author_consistency_check.name: messages_author_consistency_check
messages_author_consistency_check.value:
(
        (author_kind = 'human' and ((author_audience_user_id is not null)::int + (author_operator_id is not null)::int = 1) and author_ai_creator_id is null)
        or (author_kind = 'ai' and author_ai_creator_id is not null and author_audience_user_id is null and author_operator_id is null)
        or (author_kind = 'system' and author_audience_user_id is null and author_operator_id is null and author_ai_creator_id is null)
      )

org_memberships_org_role_required_check.name: org_memberships_org_role_required_check
org_memberships_org_role_required_check.value: "org_memberships"."team_id" is not null or "org_memberships"."role" is not null

scenes_story_order_unique.name: scenes_story_order_unique
scenes_story_order_unique.where: story_id is not null and episode_id is null
